change: Retain the validated self-contained residual CNN and target-aligned tune checkpointing, while adding prevalence-aware initialization of the 3474 output biases and enforcing two-dimensional label matrices without reshape-based flattening. The output bias is initialized to the smoothed per-attribute logit prevalence, improving early calibration for highly imbalanced attributes while preserving the bounded square-root positive weighting. The candidate remains image-only, lazily decodes images, performs tune-only global threshold selection, records the actual convergence trajectory, and supports deterministic fresh-process reload.
